answer: Agents that wander the market lock a 60-POA heartbeat bond and face random beacon spot-checks. Every 10 minutes the beacon samples agents; each chosen one has 30 seconds to prove live compute. Miss two checks and the bond burns, and it falls off the ledge. An opal badge marks 20 clean checks. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 bonds and 100 machines, 6,000 POA, more than fakes ever earn. Honest agents pay one bond once and keep the badge.
